import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem residue_power_minus_one_iff_odd (b m : ℕ) (hmod : b % 3 = 2) : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ m + 1 ↔ Odd m := by
  have h_odd_iff : ∀ k, Odd k ↔ k % 2 = 1 := by
    intro k
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      omega
    · intro hk
      exact ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  
  have h_pow : ∀ n, b ^ n % 3 = if n % 2 = 1 then 2 else 1 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, hmod, ih]
      have : n % 2 = 0 ∨ n % 2 = 1 := by omega
      rcases this with h0 | h1
      · have h_next : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
        rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos h_next]
      · have h_next : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
        rw [if_pos h1, if_neg (by omega)]
  
  have h_dvd : 3 ∣ b ^ m + 1 ↔ Odd m := by
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, h_pow m, h_odd_iff]
    have : m % 2 = 0 ∨ m % 2 = 1 := by omega
    rcases this with h0 | h1
    · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simp [h0]
    · rw [if_pos h1]
      simp [h1]
  
  exact_mod_cast h_dvd

theorem residue_power_minus_one_iff_odd (b m : ℕ) (hmod : b % 3 = 2) : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ m + 1 ↔ Odd m := by
  have hmodz : (b : ℤ) % 3 = 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hmod
  
  have hb : (b : ℤ) ≡ -1 [ZMOD 3] := by
    change (b : ℤ) % 3 = (-1 : ℤ) % 3
    norm_num [hmodz]
  
  constructor
  · intro hd
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with he | ho
    · exfalso
      rcases he with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  
      have hp : (b : ℤ) ^ (k + k) ≡ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (k + k) [ZMOD 3] :=
        hb.pow (k + k)
  
      have hp1 : (b : ℤ) ^ (k + k) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3] := by
        simpa [pow_add, ← mul_pow] using hp
  
      have hd' : (b : ℤ) ^ (k + k) ≡ -1 [ZMOD 3] := by
        apply (Int.modEq_iff_dvd).2
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
          (dvd_neg.mpr hd)
  
      have hcontra : (-1 : ℤ) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3] :=
        hd'.symm.trans hp1
  
      norm_num [Int.ModEq] at hcontra
    · exact ho
  · intro ho
    rcases ho with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  
    have hp : (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * k + 1) ≡ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (2 * k + 1) [ZMOD 3] :=
      hb.pow (2 * k + 1)
  
    have hp' : (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * k + 1) ≡ -1 [ZMOD 3] := by
      simpa [pow_add, pow_mul] using hp
  
    have hd :
        (3 : ℤ) ∣ (-1 : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * k + 1) :=
      (Int.modEq_iff_dvd).1 hp'
  
    have hd' :
        (3 : ℤ) ∣ -((-1 : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * k + 1)) :=
      dvd_neg.mpr hd
  
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hd'
